stories.title: Consent Data Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and validate MongoDB schema and Pydantic models for consent records, including tier level, timestamps, session linkage, and audit fields to ensure consistent data contracts across services.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints Exposure
stories.description: Expose consent workflow through FastAPI endpoints enabling creation, upgrade (Tier 1 to Tier 2), and retrieval of consent status for a session, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and chat flow.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration for Consent Enforcement
stories.description: Integrate consent checks into tool_router to ensure all tool executions that involve storage or identifiable data enforce consent tier requirements before execution.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering consent tier transitions, rejection paths, storage blocking, and API responses to ensure correctness and prevent regression.

stories.title: Unknown Question and Consent Flow Integration
stories.description: Ensure unknown_question_service correctly triggers consent workflow prompts and respects tier rules when capturing and storing unanswerable questions with de-identification.
